field_updates.detail: Figure 3 "Base-Emitter Voltage", curve "VBE(on) VCE = 5V" (typical characteristics, BD135/137/139 shared) Method: Pixel-digitized (102 px/decade, 333.5 px/V): IC=1.72 mA VBE=0.599 V; 2.70 mA 0.608; 5.3 mA 0.626; 13.1 mA 0.653; 25.8 mA 0.671; 125 mA 0.731 V. IS = IC/exp(VBE/Vt), Vt = 25.69 mV: 1.28e-13, 1.41e-13, 1.38e-13, 1.19e-13, 1.16e-13 over 1.7-26 mA -> 1.3e-13. Confidence L because the curve starts at 1.7 mA and its slope is ~70.5 mV/decade (N ~1.19), so an N=1 IS depends on the anchor current (5.5e-14 if anchored at 125 mA). Temperature not stated on the figure (assumed 25 C). The onsemi Rev 3 Fig. 3 p3 shows the same VBE(on) VCE = 5 V curve. Stated table point only gives a ceiling: "VBE(on) ... VCE = 2V, IC = 0.5A ... 1 V" (p1).
